description: This file is a PHP source file for a web application that manages Wi-Fi network settings, including configuration of SSIDs, security modes, passwords, and related user interface logic for the 'Home Network Wizard' step 2.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends the Wi-Fi configuration data via POST request to update the settings on the server.

methods.name: addslashes
methods.description: Escapes backslashes and double quotes in strings for safe inclusion in JSON payloads.

methods.name: click_save
methods.description: Collects form data, constructs a JSON configuration object, and initiates a server request to save the Wi-Fi settings.
